status.description: The http response code indicating the nature of completion.

time.description: The current date/time at time of response in UTC

correlationId.description: The correlationId automatically generated or the value from the request if provided.

path.description: The URI of the API request.

method.description: The HTTP method of the request

partnerID.description: The partner ID for the partner

name.description: The name of the partner organisation.

adminEmailList.description: A comma separated list of email addresses which are set as the admin contacts for this partner.

taskNotificationEmailList.description: A comma separated list of email addresses which are set as the task notification contacts for this partner. Will be present for outbound partners only.

taskNotificationMethod.description: The method which is configured for this partner to inform task notifications. Will be present for outbound partners only.

createdDate.description: Indicates the date/time in UTC when the partner record was created in WFM Partner Gateway. Format- yyyy-MM-DDThh:mi:ss.mls+hh:mi.

endDate.description: Indicates the date/time in UTC when the partner record was inactive/ the contract ended in WFM Partner Gateway. Format- yyyy-MM-DDThh:mi:ss.mls+hh:mi.

lastChangeBy.description: Indicates the source of the last change to the partner record in WFM Partner Gateway

lastChangeDate.description: The last change date/time in UTC for the partner record in WFM Partner Gateway. Format- yyyy-MM-DDThh:mi:ss.mls+hh:mi.

partnerAttributes.description: An array holding additional additional attributes of the partner.

partnerAttributesRetrievePartner.description: An array of partner attributes associated with the partner record. When called by a partner only parter manageable attributes will be returned.

name.description: The name of the attribute under the category.

subValue.description: The sub value of the attribute (if applicable)
